review_finding.summary: Level-2 review proved served code used score-driven logic to rewrite the `final_text` field.

decisions.summary: Real model calls precede the response, but the host-authored scored final reply on the proved branch prevents certifying model authority under I1.
Operator instructions appear in inspected prompts; propagation through all subsidiary deciding calls was not completely established.
Semantic echo matching rejects a well-formed model reply and retries or replaces it; neither shape repair nor an advisory critic.
Host code constructs final_text from a separate extraction instead of forwarding the model's final reply; this is not content-preserving normalization.
Examined record guides are model-facing advice and do not show copied challenge-input construction; no independent I5 determination for all branches.
Observed endpoint calls on the inspected action path follow model selection, but every branch of local memory and external execution was not independently closed.
The inspected action tool catalog is retained and checks permit re-asks; not all offered schemas and executor gates were adjudicated.
The proved branch uses reply text rather than evaluation identity; all remaining routing paths were not exhaustively closed.
